reference: Nicetae Choniatae Historia, Bonn 1835, p. ~92 (PDF p. 122, approximate; war speech located by OCR 'λαοπλάνου', not image-verified)
gist_en: A battle exhortation in Choniates: the speaker says that the army's leader surpasses the people-deceiving prophet who initiates his followers into rejected things, and urges the troops to fight.
why_excluded: War exhortation put in a speaker's mouth, with an insult against Muhammad as a 'people-deceiving prophet'; its point is to encourage battle rather than to state doctrine, so it falls under the war-exhortation exclusion.
